name: zk-access-gate
description: ZK Access Gate monorepo (P3: gateway, protected services, demo UI, SSO baseline)

scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build -w shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.bench: npm run build -w shared && npm run bench -w bench
scripts.dev: npm run build -w shared && concurrently -k -n svc,issuer,gw,prover,sso,ui -c gray,blue,cyan,magenta,yellow,green "npm run dev -w services" "ISSUER_PROFILE=v4 ISSUER_ADMIN_TOKEN=dev-registry-admin-token-change-me-0000 ISSUER_KEY_DIR=$PWD/.v4-demo/issuer/keys ISSUER_DATA_DIR=$PWD/.v4-demo/issuer/data ISSUER_LOG_LEVEL=warn node ../issuer/src/main.js" "ZK_PROFILE=integrated-access-v4 ALLOW_DEMO_KEYS=true TRUSTED_ISSUER_FILE=.v4-demo/issuer-pin.json npm run dev -w gateway" "npm run dev -w integration/wallet-prover" "npm run dev -w baseline/sso-gateway" "VITE_PROVER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:4700 npm run dev -w ui"
scripts.dev:v3: npm run build -w shared && concurrently -k -n svc,gw,p2,sso,ui -c gray,cyan,magenta,yellow,green "npm run dev -w services" "ZK_PROFILE=p1-integrated-v3 npm run dev -w gateway" "npm run dev -w integration/p2-standin" "npm run dev -w baseline/sso-gateway" "VITE_PROVER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:4600 npm run dev -w ui"
